summary: When keeping the relationship starts requiring you to give up your ability to say no, the issue is no longer how much you love each other.
body: When keeping the relationship starts requiring you to give up your ability to say no, the issue is no longer how much you love each other. When Venus squares Pluto, attachment can become tangled with money, guilt, jealousy, privacy, access, or the fear of what you will lose if you stop cooperating, making control easier to disguise as proof that the bond is important. Deep feelings do not make coercion more romantic. Notice which compromises come from genuine desire and which ones you are making because protecting your autonomy suddenly feels more expensive than protecting the connection.
